note: What gEdit still reads wrong, or leaves unread, in the owner's published programs (tests/fixtures/nc/owner-public), for exit criterion X13: every remaining unknown token outside comments and every program-map difference, each with its reason. Plan section 6 M9, P9 item 7. WP9.6 owns it; tests/unit/ownerPublic.test.ts (the TypeScript tokenizer) and tests/python/test_owner_public.py (the Python one) read it, and both must find exactly these entries.

A file that is not listed has no unknown token outside comments, and its map equals its outline golden. Every one of the 20 programs detects as its folder says whichever document was open before, opens and saves back byte for byte, and scale feed and scale speed at 100 % give back every byte of each; tool_list gives one row per station of its map. Those checks have no entry because none of them fails.

unknown: one entry per distinct token text, with how often it occurs and its first line. 'fix' names the work package expected to remove it, or 'allow' for a token that is legitimately not code, or not read as code by a decision, and stays listed with its reason.
map: the program map differs from what the program means; the expected tools are in expected/outline/owner-public/_known-gaps.json, which outline.test.ts runs as expected failures. 'fix' as above.
